text:
Rina: Quick heads-up: we just published the Community Contrib StarterKit (alpha) — a minimal scaffold to help new maintainers get a repo running with tests, CI, and contribution docs. :sparkles:
Rina: Repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/contrib-starterkit (tag: v0.0.1-alpha)
release-bot: release published: contrib-starterkit@v0.0.1-alpha — changelog: "initial scaffolds: README, tests, GH Actions, CODEOWNERS, CONTRIBUTING" — assets: https://github.com/redwood-inference/contrib-starterkit/releases/tag/v0.0.1-alpha
Tom: Nice! Is there a CLI to scaffold a new repo from the kit?
Rina: Yes — tiny node CLI included. Example:```bash
npx @redwood/contrib-init my-new-plugin
# creates repo layout with .github, docs, tests
```
Mika: Any guidance for licensing and contributor agreements in the kit? We have some maintainers that asked about CLA defaults.
Rina: CONTRIBUTING.md suggests MIT by default, with a short section on enabling a CLA bot or DCO. We intentionally left CLA optional and documented a recommended setup in docs/cla-setup.md.
Tom: Will this introduce any company policy changes for community repos?
community-eng: Short answer: no. This is a convenience template. Company policy still requires security reviews for repos that handle customer data; see internal policy in infra-team.
Mika: Can we include a small demo/workshop for the contributor onboarding flow? Might reduce confusion.
Rina: Yes — planning a 45-min demo during next week's contributor office hours. Calendar soon. Signup: https://cal.com/redwood/contrib-starterkit-demo
Tom: Suggestion: add a cookiecutter-compatible template for Python projects as well. I'll open an issue.
Rina: Great — issue welcomed. We're launching alpha to iterate fast. Please file issues/PRs for bugs or missing templates. :rocket: 
release-bot: Note: onboarding checklist added at /docs/maintainer-quickstart.md
Mika: Congrats team — looks super useful. I'll try the npx flow and report back. :thumbsup:
Rina: Thanks everyone! We'll follow up with a short post in the community forum and a how-to video after the demo.
